heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Which sports can you support?
items.answer: Cricket, football and other sports, depending on data availability.

items.question: Do you integrate live score feeds?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate sports data providers for live scoring.

items.question: Are there legal considerations?
items.answer: Rules for paid contests vary by country. Please seek legal advice for your market before launch.

items.question: How long does fantasy sports app development take?
items.answer: A launch-ready first version takes 8 to 12 weeks, while a full platform with customer, provider and admin apps takes 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
